description: A giant scorpion seen from the side, its body crossing the lower half of the picture from left to right. The armored segments of its back are glossy red and white outlined in black; pale grey legs stand beneath it. A long jointed red-and-white pincer arm reaches forward along the bottom right, ending in a claw. Two curved black limbs rise above the body against the sky: a smaller hooked one at the upper left and a larger arching one in the middle that curls over with a hooked, pincer-like tip. The background is plain light grey, giving a stark look. Frame 1: both black limbs are curled. Frame 2: the forward pincer arm shifts slightly. Frame 3: it resettles. Frame 4: the large black limb straightens and points to the right. Frame 5: it curls back. Frame 6: the small black limb at the left lifts. Frame 7: both black limbs reach outward. Frame 8: the large limb points right again. Every frame is equally quick, so the loop reads as constant nervous twitching of the limbs.
title: Giant scorpion twitching
